status_reason: Phase 0 could not archive an organizer-published contract. Every schema is provisional and isolated behind adapter/ until Q-001..Q-014 are answered.

versioning_rules.major: Incompatible change: removed field, changed meaning, changed ID namespace, changed reward semantics.
versioning_rules.minor: Backward-compatible addition: optional field, new enum member, new extension namespace.
versioning_rules.patch: Description/typo fix with no behavioral change.
versioning_rules.change_control: Any change requires a CR in docs/CR/ and a DECISIONS.md entry (REQ-CONTRACT-004).

unknown_field_policy.note: REQ-CONTRACT-003. The organizer adapter may relax this only if the official contract requires it, and the relaxation must be recorded in docs/DECISIONS.md.
